relay.shell.usage.remaining.tone: Factual, concise; no guarantee beyond explicit eligibility.
relay.shell.usage.remaining.note: {value} is a numeric amount, formatted by ICU number (up to three decimals) in the actual selected catalogue locale. {unit} is a localized measurement label; translators may reorder/rephrase the complete message to avoid forced gender/plural agreement with this invariant label. Never display a raw API unit token.

relay.shell.usage.used.tone: Factual, concise; no guarantee beyond explicit eligibility.
relay.shell.usage.used.note: {value} is a numeric amount, formatted by ICU number (up to three decimals) in the actual selected catalogue locale. {unit} is a localized measurement label; rephrase/reorder the complete sentence as needed to avoid forced gender/plural agreement.

relay.shell.usage.fraction.tone: Factual, concise; no guarantee beyond explicit eligibility.
relay.shell.usage.fraction.note: {value} is a numeric FRACTION, e.g. 0.29 means 29 percent used. ICU percent owns rounding, spacing and percent sign in the actual catalogue locale. Never multiply or append a second percent sign.

relay.shell.usage.reset.tone: Factual, concise; no guarantee beyond explicit eligibility.
relay.shell.usage.reset.note: {value} is the reset timestamp as epoch milliseconds in the phone, or datetime in Python. ICU date medium/time short formats it in the actual selected catalogue locale and the phone time zone, consistently with as_of; not an ISO machine token.

relay.shell.usage.command.tone: Factual, concise; no guarantee beyond explicit eligibility.
relay.shell.usage.command.note: Paired-phone read-only cached provider usage. Windows/families are allowlisted normalized metadata; unknown is not zero. Parameters are display amounts or reset times, never credentials.

relay.shell.usage.as_of.note: {value} is the immutable cached timestamp as epoch milliseconds in the phone, or datetime in Python. ICU date medium/time short formats it in the actual selected catalogue locale and phone time zone, consistently with reset; not the browser default locale.

relay.shell.usage.stale.note: Disclose may_be_stale from uncheckpointed WAL; do not infer freshness from per-report times.

relay.shell.usage.row.role: complete usage allowance row without a named model family
relay.shell.usage.row.note: Own the entire field order and punctuation, including the separator before the value. {label} is an already localized allowance category; {window} is an already localized time-window label, including Unknown window; {value} is the already localized amount or eligibility/status text. Reorder placeholders and use locale-appropriate punctuation; do not translate their supplied contents again. Used when family_cap is false or the family identifier is unknown, so there must be no empty family parentheses. All parameters are strings; preserve their names.

relay.shell.usage.row_family.role: complete usage allowance row with a named model family
relay.shell.usage.row_family.note: Own the entire field order and punctuation, including parentheses and the separator before the value. {label}, {window}, and {value} are already localized text as in relay.shell.usage.row. {family} is the provider's machine model-family identifier (for example opus), not prose to translate. Reorder all placeholders and use locale-appropriate punctuation. Used only when family_cap is true and the family identifier is known. All parameters are strings; preserve their names.

relay.shell.usage.unit_credits.note: Localized unit noun for API token credits. {count} is the SAME actual finite numeric measurement selected by remaining ?? used, never formatted text or the used_fraction fallback. ICU cardinal plural follows the actual served catalogue locale; Python count is int|float, phone count is number. Render the NOUN ONLY: do not insert # or repeat the count, because the outer amount message formats/prints the number exactly once. Supply needed CLDR forms for zero, one, two, fractions, negative magnitudes and large exact numeric values; other is mandatory. French exact numeric million uses its many branch with a plain plural noun and NO de (OQLF numeric-versus-spelled-million guidance); do not apply the spelled-out un million de rule to the displayed digits. Spanish exact numeric million uses many with de plus the plural noun (RAE cardinales section 6); coordinate the outer message so de occurs exactly once. Russian fractional other uses the native fractional case, not the integer-many noun form. USD stays a fixed invariant label with no count parameter and is not a conversion. Never interpolate the raw API token. English 1 credit/token/request is an intentional correction of the former fixed-plural defect, not byte-identical English extraction parity.

relay.shell.usage.unit_usd.note: Localized measurement label for API token usd. Supplied to a complete amount message, which may reorder/rephrase to avoid gender or grammatical agreement with this invariant label. USD denotes US dollars, not a conversion. Never interpolate the raw API token in place of this label.

relay.shell.usage.remaining_percent.note: {value} is a numeric FRACTION (0.29 is 29 percent). ICU percent formatting uses the actual catalogue locale and rounds to an integer; do not add another percent sign or scale the placeholder. API percent-unit amounts are percent points and normalized to fractions by the caller.

ICU percent formatting uses the actual catalogue locale and rounds to an integer; do not add another percent sign or scale the placeholder. API percent-unit amounts are percent points and normalized to fractions by the caller.

relay.shell.usage.remaining_unknown_unit.note: {value} is the numeric amount. Deliberately omit unrecognized/unknown API unit tokens rather than inventing currency, translating untrusted metadata or discarding a measured value.
